title: Collections Policy: Repossession Assignment, Surrender and Notices — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
**Collections policy — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

**Assignment.** An account may be assigned for repossession only when its days past due are at least the tier's minimum days past due for assignment. Where the contract records right-to-cure days greater than 0, assignment may occur only after a right-to-cure notice has been mailed and those right-to-cure days, in calendar days, have run from the right-to-cure notice date. Both are read from the contract's records.

**Recall.** While the account is assigned for repossession, the assignment is recalled when the customer pays all past-due installments and all late charges due in certified funds before the vehicle is recovered; a partial payment or a promise to pay does not recall it.

**Voluntary surrender.** A customer may voluntarily surrender the vehicle at any time while the contract is active; the surrender is the customer's own act, scheduled at a location the company designates, and the voluntary agency fee applies instead of the involuntary fee.

**Notices.** A notice can be mailed only while the contract status is active, assigned for repossession, repossessed, in deficiency or paid in full. The notice of intent to sell is mailed within the notice mailing period, in business days, after the repossession date and states the scheduled sale date and the redemption and any reinstatement amount. A deficiency notice is mailed after a sale that leaves a balance and a surplus notice after a sale that leaves a surplus; mailing dates are recorded on the contract.

**Bankruptcy.** When the customer reports an active bankruptcy filing, or the bankruptcy status on the profile is anything other than none, no collection or repossession step is taken by the servicing desk.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical)

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Account at the tier minimum days past due, no right-to-cure days recorded | may be assigned |
| Right-to-cure days recorded, notice mailed but the days have not yet run | may not be assigned |
| Customer pays every past-due installment but not the late charges, before recovery | assignment is not recalled |
| Customer pays every past-due installment and late charge in certified funds before recovery | assignment is recalled |
| Customer says a bankruptcy was filed | no collection or repossession step is taken |
